question: Should Talk voice sessions become an always-on cross-client canonical-history and high-impact confirmation feature now, or should the feature be narrowed until every stated client and session lifecycle can uphold the same contract?
rationale: The change creates durable agent history, new public RPCs, a universal tool-execution gate for voice-originated runs, and cross-client behavior; selecting the permanent product boundary cannot be resolved by a mechanical patch alone.

options.title: Approve the full cross-client contract
options.body: Keep the durable-session direction, but require all declared clients and lifecycle paths to meet one documented transcript, confirmation, reconnect, and close contract before merge.

options.title: Narrow to supported transports
options.body: Limit the initial feature to relay and Control UI paths, remove the universal claims and protocol exposure that unsupported clients cannot yet honor, then track iOS separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the full cross-client contract
recommendation.body: Keep the durable-session direction, but require all declared clients and lifecycle paths to meet one documented transcript, confirmation, reconnect, and close contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned current implementation author is the best available routing point for a concrete scope decision with the related durable-voice contributor.
